Get the app
Apple Watch

Your countdowns on your Apple Watch face

See the days left every time you check the time. Simple Count puts your next countdown on the Apple Watch face, and the watch app shows all of them. It's free, and it gets your countdowns from your iPhone by itself.

Put a countdown on your watch face

  1. Install Simple Count on your iPhone and add your countdowns there. The watch app installs with it (or from the App Store on the watch).
  2. The quick way: on your iPhone, open Simple Count, Settings, Apple Watch, and tap Add the Simple Count face. It adds a Modular face with your next countdown in the big middle spot.
  3. On any face: touch and hold the watch face, tap Edit, swipe to Complications, tap a spot and choose Simple Count.

What you get on the watch

  • Complications in every shape: round with the emoji and the days, a wide one with the name and the date, inline and corner ones.
  • Next Event by default: it shows whichever countdown comes first and moves on by itself. Or choose one countdown for a spot.
  • Smart Stack: the countdown rises in the Smart Stack as the day comes closer, and a Live Activity shows there in the last eight hours.
  • The watch app: all your countdowns in a list, each one full screen in its colours, with a live timer when it's less than a day away and confetti on the day.

You add and edit countdowns on the iPhone; the watch shows them. Photos stay on the iPhone. Needs watchOS 10 or later and Simple Count on your iPhone.

Questions

Is the Apple Watch app free?

Yes. The watch app, the complications and the Smart Stack widget are free, with no ads and no subscription.

Does it work without an iPhone?

No. Your countdowns come from Simple Count on your iPhone; the watch shows them and keeps them up to date by itself.

Can I add a countdown on the watch?

Not yet. Add it on your iPhone (or ask Siri on your iPhone) and it appears on the watch.
